# Deploy to Fly.io

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Deploy an app to Fly.io, optionally creating it and staging secrets first

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/deploy-fly@v1
  with:
    fly-api-token: # Fly API token (`flyctl tokens create deploy`). Prefer a deploy-scoped token.
```

## How it works

Deploy an app to Fly.io with flyctl.

Two things this handles that a bare `flyctl deploy` doesn't:

  • Secrets. `secrets:` is a newline-separated KEY=value block that is staged with
    `flyctl secrets set --stage` *before* the deploy, so the new machines boot with the
    new values in one release instead of two (a plain `secrets set` triggers its own
    restart, deploying the previous image with the new secrets first).
  • Ephemeral PR apps. `app-suffix` plus `create-if-missing` gives every PR its own app
    (`myapp-pr-42`), and `deploy-fly` cleans up nothing — pair it with a `closed`-event
    job calling `flyctl apps destroy`.

Set `image` to deploy a pre-built image (the right pattern when a build job already
pushed one), or leave it empty to build from the Dockerfile via Fly's remote builder.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fly-api-token` | **yes** | — | Fly API token (`flyctl tokens create deploy`). Prefer a deploy-scoped token. |
| `app` | no | `""` | Fly app name. Empty reads `app` from the config file. |
| `app-suffix` | no | `""` | Appended to the app name, e.g. `-pr-42` for per-PR apps. |
| `config` | no | `fly.toml` | Path to the Fly config file. |
| `working-directory` | no | `.` | Directory to run flyctl from. |
| `image` | no | `""` | Pre-built image reference to deploy. Empty builds from the Dockerfile. |
| `strategy` | no | `rolling` | immediate \| rolling \| bluegreen \| canary |
| `region` | no | `""` | Primary region for a newly created app. |
| `org` | no | `personal` | Fly organization for a newly created app. |
| `create-if-missing` | no | `false` | true to `flyctl apps create` when the app does not exist yet. |
| `secrets` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `KEY=value` secrets staged before the deploy so they land in the same release. Pass real secret values from `secrets.*`; they are never echoed. |
| `build-args` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `KEY=value` build arguments for a remote build. |
| `wait-timeout` | no | `300` | Seconds to wait for the release to become healthy. |
| `deploy-args` | no | `""` | Extra args appended to `flyctl deploy`. |
| `flyctl-version` | no | `latest` | flyctl version to install. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `app` | The resolved app name. |
| `url` | The app URL (`https://<app>.fly.dev`). |
| `created` | `true` if the app was created by this run. |
